{"reason": "Add a confidence gate and raise the exposure floor to 700000. The 20 false arbitrations (rate 0.714) include low-confidence rows (conf 0.44-0.67, e.g. pct=-0.428/exposure=1300000/conf=0.66) plus high-confidence rows at exposure 680000 and 690000. Requiring high-confidence? and exposure>700000 should remove those while keeping all 8 needed cases (recall 1.0, gate 0.8).", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
